questions.question: If a number is divided by 3, the remainder will be 2. If the number is added by 5 and then divided by 3, then what will be the remainder?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A number is divided by 3, the remainder will be 2

**Calculation:**

let the number be X

X = 3K + 2

According to question

X + 5 = 3K + 2 + 5

⇒X + 5 = 3K + 7

⇒X + 5 = 3K + 6 + 1

⇒X + 5 = 3(K + 2) + 1

Now,

3(K + 2) type number is definitely divisible by 3 so the remainder will be 1

**∴ The answer is 1.**

questions.question: (sin θ + cos θ)² = 2, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of θ is:
questions.solution:

sin2θ + cos2θ = 1

sin2θ = 2sinθcosθ

⇒1 + 2sinθcosθ = 2

⇒2sinθcosθ = 1

⇒sin2θ = 1

area of rectangle = length × breadth

questions.question: The average price of three items is Rs. 14,265. If their prices are in the ratio 7 : 9 : 11, then the price of the costliest item is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average of ratio parts (7, 9, 11) = (7 + 9 + 11) ÷ 3 = 9 units.

Given average price = Rs. 14,265.

9 units = Rs. 14,265 ⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 1,585.

Price of the costliest item (11 units) = 11 × 1,585 = Rs. 17,435.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 17,435.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Average price of 3 items = Rs. 14,265; Ratio of prices = 7 : 9 : 11.

**Formula Used:** Sum of values = Average × Number of values.

 
 
 
 7x

 11x
 Total Ratio Parts = 27x
 Average (9x) = Rs. 14,265
 Costliest Item

⇒ Total Sum of prices = 14,265 × 3 = 42,795

⇒ Let the prices be 7x, 9x, and 11x.

⇒ 7x + 9x + 11x = 42,795

⇒ 27x = 42,795

⇒ x = 42,795 ÷ 27 = 1,585

⇒ Price of costliest item = 11x = 11 × 1,585 = 17,435

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 17,435.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

General Average Formula

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Ratio Distribution

To find a specific share in ratio a:b:c, use Share = [Total Sum × specific part] ÷ (a + b + c).

Arithmetic Progression Average

For terms in AP (like our ratio parts 7, 9, 11 with difference 2), the average is always the middle term.</p

questions.question: P and Q can finish a work in 10 days and 5 days, respectively. Q worked for 2 days and left the job. In how many days can P alone finish the remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P can complete a work = 10 days

Q can complete a work = 5 days

Q worked for 2 days and remaining work finished by P

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Work/Time

**Concept Used:**

Total Work is the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of time taken by all the persons individually.

**Calculation:**

Let the remaining work can be finished by P in T days 

Total Work = LCM of 10, 5 

⇒ Total Work = 10 

Efficiency of P = 10/10 = 1

Efficiency of Q = 10/5 = 2 

Total Work = Work done by P + Work done by Q

⇒ 10 = 1 × T + 2 × 2 = T + 4

⇒ T = 10 – 4 = 6 Days

⇒ T = 6 Days

**∴ In 6 days P alone can finish the remaining work**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

LCM of 10 and 5 = 10 units= Total work

Efficiency of P = 10/10 = 1 unit/day

Efficiency of Q = 10/5 = 2 units/day

Now, Q alone worked for 2 days which means that work done by Q in 2 days = (2 × 2) = 4 units

Now, work left = (10 – 4) = 6 units

Time taken by P to complete remaining work = 6/1 = 6 days

∴ In 6 days P alone can finish the remaining work

questions.question: If one - fifth of one - fourth of a number is 35, then what is seven - eighth of that number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

1/5 of 1/4 of a number = 35

**Concept Used:**

Simply ' of ' means multiply

**Calculation:**

Let the number be N 

(1)/(5) × (1)/(4) × N = 35 

⇒ N = 35 × 5 × 4

⇒ N = 700

Seven - eighth of N = (7/8) × 700

⇒ N = 4900/8 = 612.5

**∴ Seven - eighth of Number is 612.5 **

⇒ BC² = 625 -49 = 576
